<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="טבת_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916328_theRebbe_715" batchId="meluket-_D7_98_D7_91_D7_AA_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916328_theRebbe_715__p008">
  <section v="21">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The revelation of the inwardness of miracles clothed in nature will primarily be in the future, when the boundary will no longer conceal the unlimited light.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">"11)</t>
    <t s="2">And behold, the revelation of the inwardness of the miracles that are clothed in nature</t>
    <t s="3">(the clothing being that through this the true essence of the unlimited light is revealed,</t>
    <t s="4">as above in section 9)</t>
    <t s="5">will be primarily in the future.</t>
    <t s="6">For now,</t>
    <t s="7">the boundary drawn from the name Sha-dai, from "I said to My world, 'Enough!'" and the unlimited light drawn from the name Havayah are two opposite matters.</t>
    <t s="8">Therefore there is room to say</t>
    <t s="9">that the existence of miracles clothed in nature is because in these miracles the boundary still remains</t>
    <t s="10">(drawn from "I said to My world, 'Enough!'")</t>
    <t s="11">that conceals the unlimited light of Havayah.</t>
    <t s="12">But in the future to come,</t>
    <t s="13">when the boundary will not conceal the unlimited light,</t>
    <t s="14">it will be felt in revelation that the clothing of miracles in nature is because through this the true essence of the unlimited light is revealed.</t>
    <t s="15">And this is "I did not make Myself known to them with My true attribute,"</t>
    <t s="16">that the revelation of the name Havayah now is a "true attribute,"</t>
    <t s="17">"attribute" meaning measurement and limitation,</t>
    <t s="18">that the unlimited light of Havayah is limited within the matter of the unlimited light,</t>
    <t s="19">and the revelation of Havayah that will be in the future will be above attribute</t>
    <t s="20">(as above in section 1),</t>
    <t s="21">for then,</t>
    <t s="22">even within the boundary there will be a revelation of the unlimited light51,</t>
    <t s="23">and as it is written52</t>
    <t s="24">"And the glory of Havayah shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see,"</t>
    <t s="25">that even physical flesh53</t>
    <t s="26">will see the revelation of the glory of Havayah,</t>
    <t s="27">with the coming of Mashiach our righteous one, speedily and truly.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
